training.qa_schedule: complete original QA coverage across sealed per-context event occurrences; context-balanced losses
training.curriculum: rounds 0/1: two isolated 19-context windows (sealed v4 accumulation, supervised 13->9 merge); rounds 2/3: 39-context recurrent streams compacted at the 13/9 trigger (events before writes 14 and 18)
training.teacher_scope: Full answer-content CE and KL only; EOS excluded from eligibility
training.distillation: answer-position KL(Full || Shared), averaged over eligible training QAs
training.checkpoint: last scheduled update only; no within-training selection
training.answer_supervision: one leading ASCII space + original answer; separate true EOS CE
training.objective: context-balanced targeted recovery content CE (ce_full<=2.5 and gap>0.25 -> 1+3*min(gap,2), else 0.25) + eligible Full content KL + protection content hinge + first-token Selection KL anchor + separate EOS CE
training.recovery_weight: gap = CE_Selection - CE_Full; raw = 1 + 3*min(gap, 2) if recover and CE_Full <= 2.5 and gap > 0.25, else 0.25 background anchor; recover weights normalised to mean one per event, the 0.25 anchor is absolute; the protect cohort keeps the 0.25 anchor, so its recovery CE term is non-zero by design; teacher KL eligibility stays at CE_Full <= 2.0 (2.0 < CE_Full <= 2.5 carries recovery weight but no distillation)
training.cohort_policy: native carrier origins plus untouched tail are protected; all other written original contexts recover
training.carrier_policy: unchanged content-only selector shared by Selection/C/D; no QA-conditioned selection

DsupV7.routing_score: 0.6*native 4096-D cosine + 0.4*learned rank-32 cosine, tau .04, column log-mean load balance .15; per-slot similarity hard mask (reject-only vs peer in-block baseline, margin .01)
DsupV7.gate: slotwise hidden z-score + 3 domain-agnostic geometry features (top1 affinity, top-k sharpness, in-block redundancy); zero-initialized; one logit per layer group (8 groups); sparse high-signal mask sigmoid(4*(affinity_z + .15)) keeps only the top-affinity slots active
DsupV7.delta_bound: soft-bounded tanh: delta = carrier_rms*tanh(raw/carrier_rms); no forced unit-RMS normalisation, no 1/sqrt(var+eps) zero-point amplification; global 5% RMS cap unchanged

DnativeV7.routing_score: 0.6*native 4096-D cosine + 0.4*learned rank-32 cosine, tau .04, column log-mean load balance .15; per-slot similarity hard mask (reject-only vs peer in-block baseline, margin .01)
DnativeV7.gate: slotwise hidden z-score + 3 domain-agnostic geometry features (top1 affinity, top-k sharpness, in-block redundancy); zero-initialized; one logit per layer group (8 groups); sparse high-signal mask sigmoid(4*(affinity_z + .15)) keeps only the top-affinity slots active
DnativeV7.native_path: top-2 sharpened full-width source average minus carrier, routed-confidence scaled; one zero-initialized signed gain per layer group; combined residual soft-bounded with tanh
DnativeV7.delta_bound: soft-bounded tanh on the adapted+native combined delta; no forced unit-RMS normalisation; global 5% RMS cap unchanged

protocol.compression_timing: before append; isolated pre/post queries before the next write

objective: context-balanced targeted recovery content CE (ce_full<=2.5 and gap>0.25 -> 1+3*min(gap,2), else 0.25) + eligible Full content KL + protection content hinge + first-token Selection KL anchor + separate EOS CE

dataset.scope: original SQuAD train/dev and official indices; NQ transfer reuses separately pinned processed release
dataset.verification: pinned commit resolved; byte sizes; Git blob SHA1 or LFS SHA256; local SHA256

split_audit.eligibility: E1 and training: Context-prefixed original text fits 16..512 tokens, no reader-correctness filtering
split_audit.isolation: article and exact context disjoint across train/development/formal

resources.claim: active-slot budget reduction; physical memory allocation is unchanged
